home.title: AdagioX · Comprehensive management for educational institutions
home.meta.description: AdagioX is a platform under development that brings together in a single system the academic, financial and administrative life of an educational institution and communication with families.
home.hero.title: A single system for the entire life of an educational institution
home.hero.lead: AdagioX brings together the academic, financial and administrative management of the institution and communication with families in one platform.
home.status.note: AdagioX is under development. What this page describes are product objectives, not features available today.
home.features.title: Product objectives
home.f1.title: Everything in one system
home.f1.text: Academic, financial and administrative life, and communication with families, in a single system.
home.f2.title: Several institutions, isolated data
home.f2.text: A single platform for several institutions, with the data of each institution isolated from the others.
home.f3.title: Only the modules you need
home.f3.text: Each institution activates only the modules it needs.
home.f4.title: Own brand and domain
home.f4.text: Each institution can have its own brand and its own domain.
home.f5.title: Configurable roles and permissions
home.f5.text: The institution itself configures the roles and permissions of its users.
home.f6.title: API as a goal
home.f6.text: All functionality is designed to also be available through the API.
home.f7.title: Four languages
home.f7.text: Interface in Spanish, English, German and French.
home.f8.title: Accessibility as a goal
home.f8.text: Designed with the aim of meeting the WCAG 2.2 Level AA guidelines.
home.f9.title: For public, private and state-subsidised schools
home.f9.text: The product is designed with the requirements of Spanish education and data protection regulations. This is a design objective: it does not claim any accredited conformity.
